description:
Macro data and earnings vs. expectations: actual, expected, previous, surprise. Parses releases like 'US Pending Home Sales (Sep) = -7.3% m/m (exp. -0.5% / prev. +0.3%)' and earnings lines like '3Q REV. $14.58B, EST. $12.87B' from news of the last N hours (1-168, default 24; optional q filter): indicator, actual, expected, previous, unit, surprise (actual - expected), surprise_pct and direction above/below/inline.

GET /news/data-surprises — price $0.006 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, clamped to 1-168) Default: 24.
